Assert.Equal(before, target.PasswordHash)

title: Sign in succeeds with a valid email and password (happy path).
precondition:
1. Backend and frontend are running.
2. Account thuky@trustcabinet.local is active.
3. User is not signed in.
steps:
1. Go to /login.
2. Enter Email: thuky@trustcabinet.local.
3. Enter Mật khẩu: TrustCabinet@2026.
4. Click "Đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu".
expected:
1. The button shows "Đang đăng nhập…" while waiting.
2. The meeting list (Danh sách cuộc họp) opens.
3. The sidebar shows Lịch làm việc, Cuộc họp, Kho tài liệu and Giọng nói của tôi; Người dùng & Quyền is hidden for the Secretary.

title: Sign in is refused with an empty form, an unknown email or a wrong password.
precondition:
1. Backend and frontend are running.
2. User is not signed in.
steps:
1. Go to /login and click "Đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu" with both fields empty.
2. Enter khong-ton-tai@trustcabinet.local / TrustCabinet@2026 and sign in.
3. Enter thuky@trustcabinet.local / SaiMatKhau@2026 and sign in.
expected:
1. Empty form: "Vui lòng nhập email và mật khẩu." is shown and no request is sent.
2. Unknown email and wrong password both show "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.".
3. The page stays on /login with the entered email kept.

title: A deactivated account cannot sign in.
precondition:
1. An account has been deactivated on Người dùng & Quyền.
2. Backend and frontend are running.
steps:
1. Go to /login.
2. Sign in as the deactivated account with its correct password.
expected:
1. "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." is shown.
2. The page stays on /login.

title: The session survives a page reload and ends on sign-out.
precondition: 1. Backend, Redis and frontend are running.
steps:
1. Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
2. Reload the page (F5).
3. Click "Đăng xuất" in the sidebar.
4. Open http://localhost:5173/mgmt/meetings again.
expected:
1. After reload "Đang khôi phục phiên đăng nhập…" appears briefly and the same page returns.
2. After sign-out the login page is shown.
3. The protected page redirects to /login.

title: A deactivated user is signed out at the next action.
precondition: 1. Two browsers (or one normal and one private window).
steps:
1. Sign in as thanhvien@trustcabinet.local in browser A.
2. In browser B, as quantri@trustcabinet.local, deactivate thanhvien.
3. In browser A, reload the meeting list.
expected:
1. Browser A is sent to the login page.
2. Signing in again shows "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.".

title: Sign in with a provisioned Google account.
precondition:
1. Google sign-in is enabled (Authentication:Google:Enabled, ClientId).
2. An active account with that Gmail address exists.
steps:
1. Go to /login.
2. Click the Google sign-in button.
3. Choose the Gmail account whose email an administrator created in TrustCabinet.
expected:
1. "Đang đăng nhập bằng Google…" is shown, then the meeting list opens.
2. The account is linked to Google; the next Google sign-in works the same.

title: A Google account with no TrustCabinet account is refused and no account is created.
precondition: 1. Google sign-in is enabled.
steps:
1. Go to /login.
2. Click the Google sign-in button and choose a Gmail account unknown to TrustCabinet.
expected:
1. "Tài khoản Google này chưa được cấp quyền truy cập hệ thống." is shown with the hint to choose the registered account or contact the administrator.
2. No new account appears on Người dùng & Quyền.

title: Cancelling the Google popup returns to the login page without a session.
precondition: 1. Google sign-in is enabled.
steps:
1. Go to /login.
2. Click the Google sign-in button and close the Google window.
expected:
1. "Đăng nhập bằng Google không thành công." is shown.
2. The user can sign in with a password or try Google again.

title: An administrator sends a reset link and the user sets a new password with it once.
precondition:
1. SMTP sandbox (Mailpit) is running.
2. thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is active.
steps:
1. As quantri, open Người dùng & Quyền, open the row menu of thanhvien and choose "Gửi liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu", then "Gửi liên kết".
2. Open the email in the SMTP sandbox and click the link.
3. On "Đặt mật khẩu mới", enter and repeat MotMatKhauMoiRatDai@2026 and click "Đặt lại mật khẩu".
4. Sign in with the new password.
5. Open the same link again.
expected:
1. The toast "Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu." appears.
2. After saving, "Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công. Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới." is shown.
3. The new password works and the old one does not.
4. The used link shows "Liên kết này không dùng được nữa.".

title: The reset page checks that both passwords match and that it was opened from the email.
precondition: 1. A reset link has been emailed to the user.
steps:
1. Open /reset-password directly, without a token.
2. Open the emailed link and enter two different passwords.
expected:
1. Without a token: "Trang này cần được mở từ liên kết trong email.".
2. Different passwords: "Mật khẩu nhập lại không khớp." and nothing is sent.

title: The administrator sees, searches and filters every account.
precondition:
1. Seeded accounts exist.
2. quantri@trustcabinet.local has AdminUsers.
steps:
1. Sign in as quantri@trustcabinet.local and open Người dùng & Quyền.
2. Type "thu" in "Tìm theo tên hoặc email…".
3. Choose a role in "Lọc theo vai trò" and "Đã vô hiệu hoá" in "Lọc theo trạng thái".
4. Click to clear the filters.
expected:
1. The table lists accounts with name, email, role, Trạng thái and Ngày tạo; the administrator's row is marked "Bạn".
2. The search narrows the list to matching names or emails.
3. With no match "Không có tài khoản nào khớp bộ lọc." is shown.

title: Create a new account with a role.
precondition:
1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
2. No account uses chutoa2@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Click "Tạo tài khoản".
2. Enter Họ tên: Trần Chủ Toạ, Email: chutoa2@trustcabinet.local, a password (or use the generated one and "Sao chép mật khẩu"), choose role Chủ toạ.
3. Click Lưu.
expected:
1. The toast "Tạo tài khoản thành công." appears.
2. The new account is in the list as Đang hoạt động with role Chủ toạ.
3. The new account can sign in with the password.

title: The account form refuses an empty name, an invalid or duplicate email and a missing role, keeping what was typed.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Click "Tạo tài khoản" and click Lưu with empty fields.
2. Enter email "khong-phai-email".
3. Enter email thanhvien@trustcabinet.local with a name and role and save.
4. Correct the email to a new one and save.
expected:
1. Errors "Họ tên không được để trống.", "Email không hợp lệ." and "Vui lòng chọn vai trò." appear under the fields.
2. The duplicate shows "Email đã được sử dụng." and the form keeps the typed values.
3. After the correction exactly one new account is created.

title: Edit an account's name, email and role.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Open the row menu of an account and choose "Sửa hồ sơ".
2. Change the name and the role to Thư ký and save.
expected:
1. The toast "Cập nhật tài khoản thành công." appears.
2. The row shows the new name and role.
3. If the email changes, the form warns "Đổi email sẽ đăng xuất người này khỏi mọi thiết bị.".

title: Deactivate and reactivate an account.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Open the row menu of thanhvien and choose "Vô hiệu hoá", then confirm "Vô hiệu hoá tài khoản".
2. Try to sign in as thanhvien in another browser.
3. Choose "Kích hoạt lại", then "Kích hoạt lại tài khoản".
expected:
1. The toast "Đổi trạng thái tài khoản thành công." appears and the row shows Đã vô hiệu hoá.
2. thanhvien cannot sign in while deactivated.
3. After reactivation the row shows Đang hoạt động and sign-in works again.

title: The last active administrator is protected.
precondition: 1. quantri@trustcabinet.local is the only active account with AdminUsers.
steps:
1. Open your own row (quantri).
2. Try to deactivate yourself.
3. Try to change your own role away from Quản trị viên.
expected:
1. Deactivating yourself is not offered: "Không thể tự đổi trạng thái tài khoản của mình".
2. Changing the role shows "Không thể đổi vai trò: sau thao tác này sẽ không còn tài khoản quản trị nào đang hoạt động.".

title: A reset link cannot be sent to a deactivated or Google-only account.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local; such accounts exist.
steps:
1. Open the row menu of a deactivated account.
2. Open the row menu of an account that signs in only with Google.
expected:
1. The reset action is disabled with "Tài khoản đã bị vô hiệu hoá — kích hoạt lại trước khi đặt lại mật khẩu".
2. For the Google-only account: "Tài khoản chỉ đăng nhập bằng Google — không có mật khẩu để đặt lại".

title: Restricted administration screens are hidden from other users.
precondition: 1. thuky@trustcabinet.local has no AdminUsers.
steps:
1. Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
2. Look at the sidebar.
3. Open http://localhost:5173/mgmt/admin/users directly.
expected:
1. Người dùng & Quyền and Vai trò are not in the sidebar.
2. The address shows the not-found page, the same as an unknown URL.

title: Create, rename and delete a custom role.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Open Vai trò and click "Tạo vai trò".
2. Enter Tên vai trò: Thư ký phó, Mô tả: Hỗ trợ thư ký soạn biên bản., tick MinutesEditor under "Quyền ban đầu (tuỳ chọn)" and save.
3. Open the role, rename it to Phó thư ký and click "Lưu thay đổi".
4. Click "Xoá vai trò" and confirm.
expected:
1. Toasts "Tạo vai trò thành công.", "Cập nhật vai trò thành công." and "Xoá vai trò thành công." appear in turn.
2. The role appears, is renamed and then disappears from the list.

title: A role name is required, unique and limited in length; built-in roles cannot be renamed or deleted.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Create a role with an empty name.
2. Create a role named "THƯ KÝ".
3. Try to rename or delete Quản trị viên (marked Mặc định).
expected:
1. "Tên vai trò không được để trống." is shown.
2. "Đã có vai trò dùng tên này. Hãy đặt một tên khác." is shown.
3. For a built-in role: "Đây là vai trò mặc định của hệ thống, không đổi tên hoặc xoá được. Bạn vẫn sửa được quyền của nó.".

title: A role still held by accounts cannot be deleted.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Give the custom role Thư ký phó to two accounts.
2. Click "Xoá vai trò" on it.
expected:
1. "Vai trò này vẫn còn 2 tài khoản mang. Hãy chuyển họ sang vai trò khác trước khi xoá." is shown.
2. The role stays.

title: Change a role's capabilities in the matrix; the change applies at once.
precondition: 1. Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local; thanhvien is signed in elsewhere.
steps:
1. On Vai trò, in the matrix tick MeetingCreator for Thành viên and click Lưu.
2. In another browser signed in as thanhvien, reload Cuộc họp.
expected:
1. The toast "Cập nhật phân quyền thành công." appears.
2. thanhvien now sees "Tạo cuộc họp" without signing in again.

title: The matrix refuses to remove the last AdminUsers grant.
precondition: 1. Quản trị viên is the only role with AdminUsers.
steps: 1. Untick AdminUsers for Quản trị viên and click Lưu.
expected:
1. "Cấu hình phân quyền không hợp lệ." is shown and the tick comes back.
2. The administrator keeps access.

title: The meeting list shows only meetings the user may see, with search, status filter and paging.
precondition: 1. Several meetings in different statuses exist, some owned by another creator.
steps:
1. Sign in as thuky and open Cuộc họp.
2. Type "Giao ban" in "Tìm theo tên cuộc họp…".
3. Click a status in the summary ("Lọc nhanh theo trạng thái"), e.g. Bản nháp.
4. Change the page and the rows per page.
5. Click "Xoá bộ lọc".
expected:
1. Rows show the name, status badge, Thời điểm and the sensitivity.
2. Search and status narrow the list; with no match "Không có cuộc họp nào khớp bộ lọc.".
3. Meetings of other organizers that thuky is not part of never appear.
4. Clearing returns the full list.

title: A member sees an invited meeting only after it is published.
precondition: 1. thanhvien is on the roster of one Draft and one Published meeting.
steps: 1. Sign in as thanhvien and open Cuộc họp.
expected:
1. Only Published (and later) meetings where thanhvien is invited are listed.
2. With none, "Cuộc họp bạn được mời sẽ hiện ở đây sau khi được công bố." is shown.

title: Create a Draft meeting with the required information and a roster.
precondition: 1. Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).
steps:
1. Click "Tạo cuộc họp".
2. Enter Tên cuộc họp: Giao ban tuần 40, Ngày họp: tomorrow, Bắt đầu 09:00, Kết thúc 10:00, Hình thức: Trực tiếp, Địa điểm: Phòng họp A — Tầng 4, Mức độ mật: Nội bộ.
3. In "Tìm người dự họp", add chutoa as Chủ tọa and thanhvien as Thành viên.
4. Click "Tạo cuộc họp" in the dialog.
expected:
1. The toast "Tạo cuộc họp thành công." appears.
2. The meeting detail opens with status Bản nháp and the entered information on Thông tin chung.
3. The meeting is in the list.

title: The meeting form validates the required fields and the schedule.
precondition: 1. Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Open "Tạo cuộc họp" and submit it empty.
2. Set the end time before the start time.
3. Set a start time in the past.
4. Correct everything and submit.
expected:
1. "Tên cuộc họp không được để trống.", "Vui lòng chọn ngày họp." and the time errors appear.
2. "Thời gian kết thúc phải sau thời gian bắt đầu." and "Thời gian bắt đầu phải sau thời điểm hiện tại." are shown.
3. Only the corrected submission creates exactly one meeting.

title: Closing the form with unsaved input asks first.
precondition: 1. Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
steps:
1. Open "Tạo cuộc họp", type a title and close the dialog.
2. Click "Tiếp tục soạn", then close again and click "Bỏ cuộc họp".
expected:
1. "Bỏ cuộc họp đang soạn?" is asked.
2. "Tiếp tục soạn" keeps the input; "Bỏ cuộc họp" closes without creating anything.

title: Edit a Draft meeting.
precondition: 1. thuky owns a Draft meeting.
steps:
1. Open the Draft and click "Chỉnh sửa".
2. Change the title, the time and the location and click "Lưu thay đổi".
3. Reload the page.
expected:
1. The toast "Cập nhật cuộc họp thành công." appears.
2. Thông tin chung shows the new values after reload.

title: Submit a Draft for approval to a chosen approver.
precondition: 1. Signed in as thuky; chutoa has MeetingApprover.
steps:
1. Open the demo Draft "SCRUM-19 — Luồng duyệt và công bố (demo)".
2. Click "Gửi duyệt".
3. In "Chọn người duyệt" choose Trần Chủ Toạ and click "Gửi duyệt".
expected:
1. A toast confirms the submission.
2. The status becomes Chờ duyệt; the bar shows "Đang chờ duyệt" and the approver.
3. Thông tin chung cannot be edited while waiting ("Trong lúc chờ duyệt, thông tin cuộc họp không sửa được.").
4. chutoa receives a notification.

title: A meeting with missing information cannot be submitted.
precondition: 1. thuky owns an incomplete Draft.
steps: 1. Open a Draft without a Chair (or with a blank title).
expected:
1. The bar shows "Hoàn thiện thông tin trước khi gửi duyệt" with "Cần hoàn thiện trước khi gửi duyệt:" and the missing items.
2. "Gửi duyệt" is not available.

title: The approver approves a meeting.
precondition: 1. A meeting is Chờ duyệt with chutoa as approver.
steps:
1. Sign in as chutoa and open the meeting (from the notification or the list).
2. Click "Duyệt" and confirm "Duyệt cuộc họp".
expected:
1. The toast "Đã duyệt cuộc họp." appears.
2. The status becomes Đã duyệt and the bar shows "Bạn đã duyệt cuộc họp này".
3. thuky is notified.

title: The approver rejects with a reason; the organizer revises and resubmits.
precondition: 1. A meeting is Chờ duyệt with chutoa as approver.
steps:
1. As chutoa, click "Từ chối", leave Lý do từ chối empty and confirm.
2. Enter "Cần bổ sung báo cáo tài chính vào nội dung cuộc họp." and click "Từ chối".
3. As thuky, open the meeting, edit it and click "Gửi duyệt lại".
expected:
1. Empty reason: "Cần nhập lý do từ chối.".
2. After rejecting: "Đã từ chối cuộc họp."; status Bị từ chối; thuky sees "Cuộc họp bị từ chối" with the reason.
3. Resubmission goes back to Chờ duyệt; the history keeps the rejection.

title: The organizer withdraws a waiting meeting to Draft.
precondition: 1. The assigned approver's role lost MeetingApprover.
steps:
1. As thuky, open a Chờ duyệt meeting whose approver lost MeetingApprover.
2. Click "Rút về nháp".
expected:
1. The bar shows "Người duyệt không còn quyền duyệt".
2. After withdrawing, "Đã đưa cuộc họp về bản nháp." and the status is Bản nháp.

title: Publish an approved meeting that has a Chair and a Secretary.
precondition:
1. An Đã duyệt meeting with an active Chủ tọa and Thư ký on the roster.
2. SMTP sandbox is running.
steps:
1. As thuky, open the Đã duyệt meeting.
2. Click "Công bố" and confirm "Công bố cuộc họp".
expected:
1. The toast "Đã công bố cuộc họp." appears; the status is Đã công bố.
2. Every invitee gets an in-app notification and an email invitation (with an .ics file) in the SMTP sandbox.
3. The meeting now appears in the invitees' lists and calendars.

title: Publishing is refused without a Chair and a Secretary.
precondition: 1. thuky owns an Đã duyệt meeting.
steps:
1. Remove the Thư ký from an Đã duyệt meeting.
2. Click "Công bố".
expected:
1. "Cuộc họp cần có đúng một Chủ tọa đang hoạt động và ít nhất một Thư ký đang hoạt động trước khi công bố." is shown.
2. The meeting stays Đã duyệt and no invitation is sent.

title: Reschedule a published meeting and notify the invitees.
precondition: 1. thuky owns a Published meeting with invitees.
steps:
1. Open the Đã công bố meeting and click "Dời lịch".
2. Move it one day later, change the location and click "Lưu và thông báo".
expected:
1. The toast "Đã dời lịch cuộc họp. Người được mời sẽ nhận thông báo." appears.
2. Title and sensitivity are locked ("Đã công bố, không đổi được.").
3. Invitees receive a notification and an update email; Lịch làm việc shows the new time.

title: Cancel a meeting with a reason.
precondition: 1. thuky owns a Published meeting.
steps:
1. Open a Published meeting and choose "Huỷ cuộc họp".
2. Confirm without a reason.
3. Enter "Lãnh đạo đi công tác, sẽ xếp lịch lại sau." and confirm.
expected:
1. Without a reason: "Cần nhập lý do huỷ cuộc họp.".
2. The dialog warns "Mọi người được mời sẽ nhận thông báo và email kèm lý do. Không hoàn tác được.".
3. After confirming: "Đã huỷ cuộc họp."; the page shows "Cuộc họp đã huỷ" with the reason; invitees are notified.

title: The Chair starts and ends the meeting.
precondition: 1. A Published meeting with chutoa as Chair and an active Secretary.
steps:
1. As chutoa (Chair), open a Published meeting and click "Bắt đầu họp" (confirm "Vẫn bắt đầu" if it is early).
2. Later click "Kết thúc họp" and confirm "Kết thúc cuộc họp?".
expected:
1. The status becomes Đang diễn ra and "Vào phòng họp" appears for invitees.
2. After ending, the status is Đã kết thúc and Thời gian thực tế shows the real start and end.

title: Meeting detail shows the general information and the history; restricted meetings return 404.
precondition: 1. A Published meeting and an unrelated outsider account.
steps:
1. Open a meeting you take part in; read Thông tin chung and the status history ("Xem thêm").
2. As an outsider, open the URL of that meeting.
expected:
1. Status, Mức độ, Thời gian, Hình thức, Địa điểm, Chủ tọa, Thư ký and Mô tả are shown.
2. The history lists each status change with who and when.
3. The outsider sees the not-found page.

title: The Secretary adds internal participants with a role.
precondition: 1. A Draft or Published meeting; signed in as its Secretary.
steps:
1. Open the meeting, tab "Thành phần tham dự".
2. Click "Thêm người dự họp", search by name or email, select two people, choose Vai trò Thành viên and click "Thêm".
expected:
1. The toast "Thêm thành phần tham dự thành công." appears.
2. Both people are listed with role Thành viên.
3. If the meeting is published they receive an invitation.

title: Invite a guest outside the system by email.
precondition: 1. Signed in as the meeting Secretary; SMTP sandbox running.
steps:
1. Click "Mời khách ngoài hệ thống (qua email)".
2. Click "Mời" with empty fields, then enter Tên khách: Khách, email guest@example.test and click "Mời".
expected:
1. Empty: "Nhập tên khách." and "Nhập email hợp lệ.".
2. After inviting, the guest is listed with the tag Khách and receives an email invitation.

title: Change roles and hand over the Chair.
precondition: 1. A meeting with Chair, Secretary and members.
steps:
1. Open a participant's menu, choose "Đổi vai trò", pick Thư ký and Lưu.
2. As the Chair of a Published meeting, choose "Giao Chủ tọa" for a member and confirm.
expected:
1. "Cập nhật vai trò cuộc họp thành công." appears and the role changes.
2. "Giao vai trò Chủ tọa thành công." appears; the member is Chủ tọa and the former Chair is Thành viên.

title: Remove a participant and revoke a guest; the last Secretary is kept.
precondition: 1. A meeting with one Secretary, a member and a guest.
steps:
1. Choose "Gỡ khỏi cuộc họp" for a member and confirm.
2. Choose "Thu hồi lời mời" for a guest and confirm.
3. Try to remove the only Thư ký.
expected:
1. "Gỡ thành phần tham dự thành công." appears; the removed member no longer sees the meeting.
2. The guest invitation is revoked.
3. Removing the last Secretary shows "Cuộc họp phải giữ Chủ tọa và Thư ký theo quy định. Hãy phân công người thay thế.".

title: An invitee answers the invitation.
precondition: 1. thanhvien is invited to a Published meeting.
steps:
1. Sign in as thanhvien and open the published meeting.
2. At "Bạn có tham dự cuộc họp này?" click "Tham dự".
3. Change the answer to "Không tham dự".
expected:
1. "Đã ghi nhận phản hồi lời mời." appears and "Đã xác nhận tham dự" is shown.
2. The Secretary sees the answer on the roster.
3. After declining, the meeting no longer shows in thanhvien's calendar.

title: Two Secretaries changing the roster at once: the later one is asked to reload.
precondition: 1. A draft meeting; signed in as its Secretary.
steps:
1. Open the roster as the Secretary in two tabs.
2. Add a person in tab 1.
3. Without reloading, add another person in tab 2.
expected:
1. Tab 2 shows "Danh sách thành phần đã thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.".
2. After reloading, the add succeeds and both people are listed.

title: A deactivated participant is marked on the roster.
precondition: 1. A meeting with that participant.
steps:
1. Deactivate a participant's account on Người dùng & Quyền.
2. Open the roster.
expected: 1. The person shows the tag "Tài khoản đã khoá".

title: The Secretary builds the agenda: add, edit, reorder and delete items.
precondition: 1. A Draft or Published meeting with documents; signed in as its Secretary.
steps:
1. Open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" and click "Thêm nội dung".
2. Enter Nội dung cần bàn: Dự toán ngân sách năm 2027, choose Người trình bày and a document, click Lưu.
3. Add two more items and drag one to a new position ("Kéo để đổi vị trí").
4. Edit an item ("Sửa"), then delete one ("Xoá nội dung").
expected:
1. Toasts "Tạo mục nghị sự thành công.", "Sắp xếp mục nghị sự thành công.", "Cập nhật mục nghị sự thành công." and "Xóa mục nghị sự thành công." appear.
2. Without a title: "Vui lòng nhập nội dung cần bàn.".
3. Other participants see the agenda update live.

title: The Chair runs the agenda during the meeting and records conclusions.
precondition: 1. A Published meeting with agenda items; chutoa is Chair.
steps:
1. Start the meeting as the Chair.
2. Start the first item, then try to start a second one.
3. Complete the first item.
4. Click "Ghi kết luận", enter a conclusion and click "Lưu kết luận".
expected:
1. Starting a second item shows "Đã có mục nghị sự đang diễn ra.".
2. The completed item is marked done with actual times.
3. "Lưu kết luận mục nghị sự thành công." appears and the item shows "Đã kết luận".

title: An empty agenda guides the Secretary and members only read it.
precondition: 1. A published meeting; thanhvien is invited.
steps:
1. As the Secretary, open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" of a meeting with no item.
2. As thanhvien, open the same tab of the published meeting.
expected:
1. The Secretary sees "Chưa có nội dung nào" with "Thêm các nội dung cần bàn trong cuộc họp." and "Thêm nội dung".
2. The member sees the items but no add, edit, delete or drag actions.

title: Closing the item form with unsaved changes asks first.
precondition: 1. Signed in as the meeting Secretary; the agenda has items.
steps:
1. Open "Sửa" on an item, change the title and close the dialog.
2. Choose "Tiếp tục sửa", close again and choose "Bỏ thay đổi".
expected:
1. "Bỏ thay đổi chưa lưu?" is asked.
2. "Bỏ thay đổi" closes without saving; the item keeps its old title.

title: The agenda is locked once the meeting has ended.
precondition: 1. An ended meeting with agenda items.
steps: 1. Open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" of an ended meeting as its Secretary.
expected:
1. No add, edit, delete or drag action is offered.
2. Conclusions can still be read.

title: A presenter is notified when assigned to an item of a published meeting.
precondition: 1. A published meeting with thanhvien invited.
steps:
1. As the Secretary, edit an item and choose thanhvien as Người trình bày; save.
2. As thanhvien, open the notification bell.
expected:
1. thanhvien receives a notification about presenting the item.
2. Assigning yourself as presenter does not notify you.

title: Upload meeting documents from the computer.
precondition: 1. A Published meeting; signed in as its Secretary; file storage configured.
steps:
1. Open tab "Tài liệu" and add documents ("Tải từ máy").
2. Drop two PDFs and one DOCX in "Kéo tệp vào đây hoặc bấm để chọn" and confirm.
expected:
1. The upload tray shows each file; then "Đã thêm tài liệu vào cuộc họp.".
2. The files are listed under Tài liệu chung and copied into the uploader's Kho tài liệu.

title: Upload limits and wrong file types are refused.
precondition: 1. Signed in as the meeting Secretary.
steps:
1. Try to add a PNG renamed to .pdf.
2. Try to add 11 files at once.
3. Try a PDF larger than 50 MB.
expected:
1. The wrong type is refused with "Hãy chọn tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ, mỗi tệp không quá 50 MB." and nothing is added.
2. 11 files: "Mỗi lần tải tối đa 10 tệp, tổng dung lượng không quá 200 MB.".
3. The large file is refused naming the 50 MB limit.

title: Attach documents to an agenda item and remove them.
precondition: 1. A meeting with agenda items and documents; signed in as Chair or Secretary.
steps:
1. Under an agenda item click "Thêm tài liệu cho mục này" and pick a meeting document.
2. Use "Gỡ khỏi mục này".
3. Use "Gỡ khỏi cuộc họp" on a general document.
expected:
1. "Đã gắn tài liệu vào mục nghị sự." then "Đã gỡ tài liệu khỏi mục nghị sự." appear.
2. A document removed from the meeting disappears from every list.

title: Read a document and comment on a page.
precondition: 1. A Published meeting with a PDF; thanhvien is invited.
steps:
1. As thanhvien, open a PDF from tab Tài liệu.
2. Zoom in and out ("Phóng to", "Thu nhỏ").
3. Open Góp ý, tick "Gắn trang", write "Xem lại số liệu" and click "Gửi góp ý"; reply to it.
expected:
1. The document opens full screen with "‹ Tài liệu" to go back.
2. "Đã gửi góp ý." appears; the comment shows the page number and the reply joins its thread.
3. In a Secret meeting the document can only be viewed ("Cuộc họp Mật: tài liệu chỉ xem trực tuyến, không tải về").

title: Add documents from my library to the meeting.
precondition: 1. The Secretary has documents in Kho tài liệu.
steps:
1. In tab Tài liệu, add documents and choose "Từ kho của tôi".
2. Select two library documents and confirm.
expected:
1. "Đã thêm tài liệu vào cuộc họp." appears.
2. The meeting uses the current names; renaming them later in the library does not rename them in the meeting.

title: Documents of an ended or cancelled meeting stay readable but cannot be changed or commented.
precondition: 1. An ended and a cancelled meeting with documents.
steps:
1. Open tab Tài liệu of an ended meeting and open a document.
2. Repeat for a cancelled meeting.
expected:
1. Documents open; add and remove actions are not offered.
2. The comment panel says "Cuộc họp đã kết thúc nên không góp ý thêm được." or "Cuộc họp đã huỷ nên không góp ý thêm được.".

title: The Secretary records attendance during the meeting.
precondition: 1. A meeting with members; signed in as its Secretary.
steps:
1. Start the meeting.
2. On the roster, set members to Có mặt or Vắng in the Điểm danh column.
3. Try the same on a meeting that has not started.
expected:
1. "Lưu điểm danh thành công." appears and each row shows who recorded it and when.
2. On a meeting not in progress: "Chỉ được điểm danh khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra.".

title: Members see attendance but cannot change it.
precondition: 1. A meeting in progress where thanhvien is invited.
steps: 1. As thanhvien, open the roster of a meeting in progress.
expected:
1. The Điểm danh column is visible (Có mặt, Vắng, Chưa điểm danh).
2. No control to change attendance is offered.

title: Guests are recorded too and the recorder and time are shown.
precondition: 1. A meeting in progress with a guest invitation.
steps:
1. As the Secretary, set the guest to Có mặt.
2. Hover the attendance of the guest.
expected:
1. The guest row (tag Khách) saves like a member.
2. The tooltip shows who recorded it and when, e.g. "Nguyễn Thư Ký điểm danh lúc 09:05 23/10/2026".

title: Join the online meeting room with camera and microphone.
precondition: 1. A Published online meeting; LiveKit configured; browser camera and microphone allowed.
steps:
1. After the Chair starts an online meeting, click "Vào phòng họp".
2. Check the preview ("Xem trước hình của bạn"), toggle "Tắt micro" / "Bật camera" and click "Vào phòng".
3. Open Người dự, Tin nhắn and Tài liệu in the room.
4. Click "Rời phòng".
expected:
1. The room opens full screen; other participants appear with their names and "Đang nói" indicators.
2. Chat messages appear for people in the room only.
3. Leaving returns to the meeting page.

title: The room is closed before the start and for in-person meetings; only the Chair mutes others.
precondition: 1. Meetings as described.
steps:
1. Open the room of a meeting that has not started.
2. Open the room of an in-person meeting in progress.
3. In a running room, as a member try to mute someone; as the Chair, mute a member ("Tắt mic").
expected:
1. Not started: "Phòng họp chỉ mở khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra".
2. In person: the room says the meeting is held in person.
3. Only the Chair has "Tắt mic"; the member's microphone turns off.

title: Share the screen and use the floating window.
precondition: 1. A running online meeting room with two participants.
steps:
1. In the room, click "Chia sẻ màn hình" and choose a window.
2. Click "Dừng chia sẻ".
3. Click "Mở cửa sổ nổi", switch to another tab, then "Đóng cửa sổ nổi".
expected:
1. Others see the shared screen and "Bạn đang trình bày cho mọi người" is shown to you.
2. In the floating window "Bạn vẫn đang trong phòng và có thể làm việc khác ở tab hoặc ứng dụng khác." and the call continues.

title: Open a meeting document from inside the room.
precondition: 1. A running online meeting with documents.
steps: 1. In the room, open Tài liệu and click a document.
expected:
1. The document opens in a new tab ("Mở ở tab mới, bạn vẫn ở trong phòng").
2. The call in the first tab keeps running.

title: The Secretary records or uploads a recording with consent and gets a transcript.
precondition: 1. An InProgress meeting; signed in as its Secretary; speech worker running.
steps:
1. Open tab "Bản ghi" during the meeting.
2. Click "Bắt đầu ghi âm", enter Mục đích ghi âm "Lập biên bản cuộc họp", tick the consent statement and click "Bắt đầu ghi"; later stop and save ("Lưu tệp ghi âm").
3. Or click "Tải tệp ghi âm lên" and choose an audio file.
4. Open "Nghe và xem bản gỡ băng".
expected:
1. "Đã lưu bản ghi." appears; the recording shows Ghi trực tiếp or Tải lên and "Đang chuyển chữ".
2. When done it shows "Có bản gỡ băng"; the transcript lists speakers and times.
3. Without ticking consent the recording cannot start.

title: The Secretary corrects the transcript and names speakers; members only listen.
precondition: 1. A recording with a completed transcript.
steps:
1. In the transcript click "Sửa đoạn này", change the text and Lưu.
2. Assign "Người nói 1" to a participant.
3. As thanhvien, open the same transcript.
expected:
1. "Đã lưu đoạn gỡ băng." and "Đã gán người nói." appear.
2. thanhvien can listen and read but has no edit actions.

title: Delete a recording; the audio and transcript are erased.
precondition: 1. A stored recording; signed in as the Secretary.
steps: 1. Click "Xoá bản ghi" and confirm.
expected: 1. "Đã xoá bản ghi." appears; the audio and its transcript are erased; the row shows Đã xoá and can no longer be played.

title: Per-microphone capture turns each participant's sentences into text.
precondition: 1. An InProgress meeting whose Cách ghi âm is per microphone; speech worker running.
steps:
1. In a per-microphone meeting room, open Lời nói and click "Ghi lời tôi".
2. Say a sentence and pause.
3. Delete one of your sentences ("Xoá câu này").
expected:
1. The status shows "Đang ghi"; each sentence appears as text under your name.
2. Deleting shows "Đã xoá câu nói." and the sentence leaves the transcript.

title: Create nested folders and upload documents into the personal library.
precondition: 1. Signed in as any active user; file storage configured.
steps:
1. Open Kho tài liệu and click "Thư mục mới"; enter Báo cáo and click "Tạo thư mục".
2. Open Báo cáo, create Quý 3 inside it.
3. Click "Tải tài liệu lên" and upload Tờ trình.pdf and Dự thảo.docx.
expected:
1. "Đã tạo thư mục." appears for each folder.
2. "Đã tải tài liệu lên kho của bạn." appears; the files are listed with Tên, Kích thước and Ngày tạo.
3. "Bộ nhớ tài liệu của cả hệ thống" shows the space used.

title: Rename, move, search and delete in the library.
precondition: 1. The user has folders and documents in the library.
steps:
1. Rename a document ("Đổi tên") and a folder.
2. Move a document with "Chuyển đến…" into another folder.
3. Search "Báo cáo" in "Tìm trong thư mục này…" and filter by file type.
4. Delete an empty folder, then try to delete a folder that still has files.
expected:
1. "Đã đổi tên thư mục." and "Đã chuyển tài liệu." appear.
2. Search only covers the open folder.
3. The empty folder is deleted; the other shows "Chỉ xoá được thư mục rỗng.".

title: Folders nest at most 5 levels and cannot move into themselves.
precondition: 1. Signed in as any active user.
steps:
1. Create folders 5 levels deep, then try a sixth.
2. Try to move a folder into its own subfolder.
expected:
1. The sixth level is refused: "Thư mục chỉ lồng tối đa 5 cấp".
2. The move is refused and nothing changes.

title: An administrator reads a deactivated person's library, read-only and logged.
precondition: 1. A deactivated account with library content.
steps:
1. As quantri, on Người dùng & Quyền open the menu of a deactivated account and choose "Xem kho tài liệu".
2. Open a folder and a document.
3. Try the same for an active account.
expected:
1. The library opens with "Chỉ xem. Mỗi lần mở thư mục hoặc tài liệu đều được ghi vào nhật ký.".
2. Every open is written to the audit log.
3. For an active account the action is not offered ("Chỉ xem được kho của tài khoản đã vô hiệu hoá").

title: Switch calendar views and open a meeting.
precondition: 1. The user has meetings across several weeks.
steps:
1. Open Lịch làm việc.
2. Switch between Tuần làm việc, Cả tuần, Tháng and Danh sách; click Hôm nay and move between weeks.
3. Click a meeting to see its overview, then open its detail.
expected:
1. Meetings appear at their local times in each view; today is highlighted.
2. The overview shows time, Hình thức, Địa điểm and Chủ tọa.
3. The correct meeting detail opens.

title: Calendar filters by status and sensitivity; restricted meetings stay hidden.
precondition: 1. Meetings in several statuses exist.
steps:
1. Open "Bộ lọc", choose a status and Mức độ, tick "Gồm cả cuộc họp nháp".
2. Click "Đặt lại".
expected:
1. Only matching meetings remain; with none, "Không có cuộc họp nào khớp bộ lọc trong khoảng này.".
2. Meetings the user may not see never appear.

title: An invitee answers from the calendar.
precondition: 1. thanhvien is invited to a published meeting that has not been answered.
steps:
1. As thanhvien, open a published meeting in the calendar.
2. At "Xác nhận tham dự?" choose to attend.
expected: 1. The answer is saved and the calendar entry shows it.

title: Receive a notification live and mark it read.
precondition: 1. Two browsers; Redis and the notification hub are running.
steps:
1. Sign in as chutoa in browser A.
2. In browser B, as thuky, submit a meeting to chutoa for approval.
3. In browser A, open the bell ("Thông báo") and click the notification.
expected:
1. The bell's unread count increases without reloading.
2. Clicking opens the meeting and the notification becomes read.

title: Mark all notifications read; an old notification to a meeting no longer visible is handled.
precondition: 1. The user has several notifications, one for a meeting they were removed from.
steps:
1. Click "Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc" and reload.
2. Click an old notification of a meeting from which the user was removed.
expected:
1. The unread count is 0 after reload.
2. "Thông báo này không còn khả dụng." is shown and no meeting content is revealed.

title: A reminder arrives before a published meeting starts.
precondition: 1. The notification worker is running.
steps:
1. Publish a meeting that starts in about 15 minutes.
2. Wait until 15 minutes before the start as an invitee.
expected:
1. Each active invitee receives one reminder notification.
2. No duplicate reminder is sent.

title: Turn on Voice ID with consent and record voice samples.
precondition: 1. Microphone allowed; speech worker running.
steps:
1. Open Giọng nói của tôi and read the notice (Mục đích, Lưu gì, Dùng ở đâu, Quyền của bạn, Bên kiểm soát dữ liệu).
2. Tick the consent statement and click "Đồng ý và bật".
3. Click "Ghi giọng mẫu", read the text, click "Dừng và lưu"; record a second sample.
expected:
1. Without ticking, Voice ID cannot be turned on.
2. After consent the status is "Đang bật".
3. Each good sample is listed; a bad one (noise, two voices) is refused with the reason.

title: Turn Voice ID off and erase the samples.
precondition: 1. Voice ID is on with samples.
steps: 1. Click to turn off Voice ID and confirm "Tắt và xoá".
expected:
1. "Tắt nhận diện giọng nói?" is asked first.
2. The samples are erased; automatic speaker suggestions for this user stop.
3. Names the Secretary already assigned in transcripts stay.

title: Delete one voice sample.
precondition: 1. Voice ID is on with two samples.
steps: 1. Click "Xoá giọng mẫu" on one sample and confirm.
expected:
1. "Đã xoá giọng mẫu." appears and the sample leaves the list.
2. With fewer than 2 samples the page asks to record more.

title: Provision access, create a meeting and revoke permission
precondition: AdminUsers; MeetingCreator role; new user; staging PostgreSQL/Redis.
steps:
1. Create user and assign role.
2. Sign in as user.
3. Create Draft.
4. Remove creation capability.
5. Reload and retry creation.
expected: Creation succeeds while authorized and fails after revocation; original Draft remains intact.

title: Draft, submission, rejection, revision and approval
precondition: Separate active organizer/approver; ready meeting; notification worker.
steps:
1. Create and submit Draft.
2. Read notification and reject with reason.
3. Revise and resubmit.
4. Approve.
5. Inspect history.
expected: Transitions/recipients are correct; reasons and history persist; unauthorized actions fail.

title: Publication, notifications, email and Calendar
precondition: Approved fixture with active Chair/Secretary and participants; seeded roster; SMTP sandbox; workers enabled.
steps:
1. Publish.
2. Receive notification and ICS email.
3. Follow notification.
4. Compare Calendar and details.
expected: Published status and schedule agree; intended recipients receive invitation; retries do not duplicate; outsiders receive no data.

title: Synchronize published meeting reschedule
precondition: Published meeting; participants; original invitation recorded; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Reschedule.
2. Inspect history.
3. Check bell, update email and Calendar.
4. Reload both browsers.
expected: All screens show latest schedule; history records change; updates contain new time.

title: Deactivate, revoke sessions and restore access
precondition: Independent admin; target signed in on two tabs; not final admin.
steps:
1. Deactivate target.
2. Try reading/editing from both tabs.
3. Reactivate.
4. Sign in again.
expected: Operations fail while inactive; new sign-in succeeds after reactivation; old sessions cannot bypass active-user checks.

title: Reset password across email and authentication
precondition: Administrator/test user; SMTP sandbox; issued reset link.
steps:
1. Request reset.
2. Complete through email.
3. Try old/new passwords.
4. Reuse token.
5. Check old sessions against auth contract.
expected: Old password fails; new one works; token is single-use; session revocation follows backend contract.

title: Isolate meeting data across roles
precondition: Organizer, assigned approver, participant, outsider; Draft/WaitingApproval/Published fixtures.
steps:
1. Open list/details as each role.
2. Try history, edit and transitions.
3. Replace approver and retry as former approver.
expected: Access follows relationship/state; unrelated or revoked users cannot read restricted data; inaccessible records return 404.

title: Recover queued email after SMTP outage
precondition: Isolated staging; controllable SMTP sandbox; valid Approved fixture.
steps:
1. Stop SMTP.
2. Publish.
3. Inspect retry state.
4. Restart SMTP and allow retry.
5. Compare mail and queue.
expected: Publication persists; email retries after recovery without duplicate deduplication keys.

title: Operate agenda through complete meeting UI
precondition: Blocked: agenda UI and meeting-start workflow unavailable in this checkout.
steps:
1. Create/reorder agenda in UI.
2. Start meeting.
3. Start/finish item as Chair.
4. Observe participant browser.
expected: After integration, order/state/duration synchronize according to API; re-execute workflow.

title: Administer user access
precondition: Administrator representative; disposable accounts.
steps:
1. Create user and role.
2. Assign capabilities.
3. Deactivate/reactivate.
4. Confirm permitted work.
expected: Tasks are usable; permissions correct; final administrator protected.

title: Prepare a meeting
precondition: Organizer with MeetingCreator.
steps:
1. Create Draft with schedule/location/content.
2. Edit.
3. Find and reopen.
expected: Information persists; organizer confirms form supports preparation.

title: Review meeting requests
precondition: Organizer/approver representatives; ready meetings.
steps:
1. Submit.
2. Approve one meeting.
3. Reject another with reason.
4. Check feedback.
expected: Parties understand outcomes/reasons; history identifies reviewer.

title: Receive correct invitation
precondition: Approved fixture with roster; participant; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Publish.
2. Read notification and ICS email.
3. Open details and Calendar.
expected: Meeting/time/location/content agree across channels.

title: Understand schedule change
precondition: Published meeting; organizer and participant.
steps:
1. Reschedule.
2. Find new time through notification and Calendar.
3. Confirm applicable time.
expected: Participant recognizes latest time without contradictory information.

title: Protect meeting information
precondition: Participant and unrelated-user representatives.
steps:
1. Open invited meeting.
2. Search/enter URL as outsider.
3. Review with administrator.
expected: Participant sees permitted data; outsider cannot view restricted content.

title: Reset forgotten password
precondition: Administrator/user representatives; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Request reset.
2. Read email and change password.
3. Sign in again.
expected: User can follow instructions; consumed link cannot be reused.

title: Use supported browsers
precondition: Chrome/Edge; record versions and screen sizes in evidence.
steps:
1. Sign in.
2. Find meeting.
3. Open Calendar.
4. Read notifications.
5. Record suggestions.
expected: No UI defect blocks tasks; feedback is recorded separately from acceptance.
